note: Crystal Resort type: one row of pale-timber chalets, steep roofs, shallow turquoise water.
Seastar type: two rows of dark timber villas flanking a wide boardwalk, golden hour, open sea.
Lato-Lato type: red-orange roofs, white walls, white-railed walkway, shallow aqua water.
Aminah type: plain thatched-roof timber chalets, narrow walkway, shallow turquoise water.
Pakej Bandar: the Semporna town pier and its moored boats. Not a water resort.

Sisipan type: a row of honey-timber chalets seen along the walkway, late light.
